title: Disappointed has Lead in this.
text:
Disappointed has Lead in this.. This looks good, and it’s heavy.
I have tried to find what this is made of, and it keeps advertising the handles are stainless, so you don’t get burned! That’s a new one!

This pan also does Not pass prop 65. Which is not good.
Now I noticed someone has said this has Lead in it!
If I use this, I would put on top Parchment paper for baking. Also easy to clean up after.

Not so sure I would put my food on this, as it can’t even pass the FDA!

Disappointed
Only deserves 2 stars. It looks good!

product_metadata.title: Cuisinart CNPO-700 Non-Stick, Oval Grilling Pan, 13" x 8"
features: STAINLESS STEEL HANDLES: The raised stainless steel handles on the topper prevent your hands from coming in contact with the hot surface and make it easy to remove from your grill.
NON-STICK COATING: The non-stick material features grill ribs that elevate food and collect cooking drippings and excess oil.
EASY CLEANING: Non-stick inside and out delivers great food release with quick cleanup; roasting pan style grill topper is safe up to 400⁰F (higher temperatures might cause discoloration).
PROVIDES ALTERNATIVE TO KABOBS: Provides great substitute for a typical kabob, keeps foods from fall through the cooking grate without the need for skewers.
description: The Cuisinart 13" x 8" Non-Stick Oval Grilling Pan helps any grilling enthusiast cook a variety of delicate foods on the grill without allowing them to fall through the grate. The roasting style pan is 13" x 8" and is great for fish, seafood, and vegetable. The non-stick material features grill ribs that elevate food and collect cooking drippings and excess oil. The raised stainless steel handles on the topper prevent your hands from coming in contact with the hot surface. Non-stick inside and out delivers great food release with quick cleanup; roasting pan style oval grill topper is safe up to 400⁰F.
